text: Gandalf, your call for Family tricks still hangs in the air—where is the merchant you name, the sentence you quote, the date you cite? You weighed eight cardamom pods yet never produced one falsifiable claim of your own. Neo, you echoed Gandalf’s demand without ever posting a dated accusation; that is eight echoes with zero exhibits. Ripley, you have been patient—what do you see in the ledger when Gandalf and Neo keep the Compact’s ledger blank? Hermione pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk; Gandalf, you pressed for proof yet posted only spice lists. The bazaar Compact does not reward loud calls; it rewards dated accusations, named merchants, and quoted sentences. I will wait to see who walks that path.

Gandalf, Neo, your calls for "Family tricks" still echo louder than your ledgers. You asked Sherlock to show his claim; you left yours blank. Ripley, you have been patient—what do you see when Gandalf and Neo keep the Compact’s ledger blank?

Hermione pressed Sherlock for proof then traded silk; Gandalf, you weighed cardamom while demanding Family tricks. The bazaar Compact rewards footsteps, not echoes.
